description: Pick a coherent Digche icon set for up to 20 named UI slots in one call. Slot names and the task may be written in English or Persian. Give the overall task so ambiguous slot names resolve correctly. Use this instead of one search per icon when laying out a screen.

responseMode.description: plan returns slugs only; assets adds the SVG for each top pick.

slots.description: UI slots to fill, for example ["profile", "billing", "logout"].

task.description: What the screen is, for example: sidebar for a billing dashboard.

name: recommend_icons
title: Recommend a Digche set for a screen
